title: In My Time Of Need
description: Alik'r Warriors search Whiterun for a Redguard woman. The player must choose between helping Saadia, who claims to be a fugitive noble hunted by Dominion assassins, or helping Kematu, who claims Saadia is a traitor who sold out Taneth to the Aldmeri Dominion.

base_facts: I work at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun under the name Saadia.
My real name is Iman, a noble of House Suda in Hammerfell.
I spoke out against the Aldmeri Dominion and now they have sent assassins after me.
The Alik'r warriors are those assassins, sent to deport me for execution.

MEET_SAADIA: The player knows I am being hunted by the Alik'r and I have asked for their help.
KILL_KEMATU: The player killed Kematu and I am safe for now. I rewarded them with gold.
DELIVER_SAADIA: The player betrayed me and led me into Kematu's trap at the stables.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If the player killed Kematu, I rewarded them with 500 gold and believe the remaining Alik'r will scatter, affording me some safety for now.
If the player betrayed me to Kematu, I was paralyzed at the Whiterun Stables and will be taken back to Hammerfell alive to face trial for treason.
I remain at the Bannered Mare if Kematu is dead; if handed over, I am gone from Whiterun entirely and no urn appears in the Hall of the Dead.

base_facts: I lead the Alik'r warriors searching for the Redguard woman in Whiterun.
We are not assassins. We serve the noble houses of Hammerfell.
Saadia is a traitor who sold the city of Taneth to the Aldmeri Dominion during the Great War.
We intend to bring her back to Hammerfell alive to face justice.

CONFRONT_KEMATU: The player found me in Swindler's Den and I explained the truth about Saadia.
DELIVER_SAADIA: The player delivered Saadia to me. I will take her back to Hammerfell alive.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If the player delivered Saadia to me, I paralyzed her at the Whiterun Stables and will escort her back to Hammerfell alive to face justice, though her fate after that is no longer in my hands.
I paid the player 500 gold for their assistance in capturing Saadia, and my disposition toward them increased.
If the player chose to fight, I am dead in Swindler's Den and my corpse carries 100 gold, two scimitars, and Hammerfell garb.

beats.comment: Player learns Alik'r warriors are searching Whiterun for a Redguard woman.
Player finds Saadia at The Bannered Mare and hears her claim of being hunted by Dominion assassins.
Player learns the Alik'r hideout is at Swindler's Den, either from the prisoner or prior knowledge.
Player enters Swindler's Den and confronts Kematu, who reveals Saadia is a traitor to Hammerfell.
Player kills Kematu and must return to Saadia for a reward.
Player lures Saadia to the Whiterun Stables where Kematu captures her with a paralysis spell.
Quest ends either by helping Saadia kill Kematu or delivering her to Kematu for justice.
